events.title: Protests reach Nairobi's centre
events.body: Demonstrations against the finance bill converge on the parliamentary district in Nairobi, organised largely online and without formal leadership.

events.title: Parliament breached
events.body: As MPs pass the bill, protesters breach the parliamentary complex. Police use live fire against crowds; rights bodies later document deaths in the dozens across the protest period.

events.title: The bill is declined
events.body: President William Ruto announces he will not sign the bill and returns it to Parliament. The disputed measures are withdrawn.
